objectives.title: A Letter from Nowhere
objectives.text: Someone on this island wrote to you. Find out who sealed the letter, and why.
hints: Talk to the harbourmaster on the pier, then follow his directions into the village.
Hester at the Gull & Lantern inn (north side of the market square) can give you a room and a lead.
Show the letter to Ione Calder at the Archive, the tall stone building west of the square.

objectives.title: The Old Road
objectives.text: The way to Kestrel Keep runs through the Mosswood, sealed by thorns where 'the stones sing'. Find the old song and wake the stones.
hints: Hester knows songs nobody else on the island remembers. Wren, the ranger, knows the forest.
The Singing Stones stand in a ring north of the forest crossroads, on the old road where it climbs toward the cliffs.
Strike the stones in the order the lullaby names the animals. Read it again from the book Hester gave you.

objectives.title: The Silent Keep
objectives.text: The road is open. Explore Kestrel Keep and learn why its great lantern went dark.
hints: Follow the old road up the gorge to the gatehouse. Old places have old guards: be ready to fight.
Look for the Warden's study in the north-west of the Keep, and for a hall full of mirrors near the Lantern Tower.
In the Sun Court, turn the mirrors so the beam of light travels to the crystal in the north wall. Then climb the tower.

objectives.title: Beneath the Keep
objectives.text: The lantern is empty. Something was carried below. Find the way down and follow it.
hints: There was a key at the top of the tower. Ione thinks the old halls are reached through the courtyard cistern.
In the Hall of Echoes, stand at each of the three glowing pools to see what they remember.
Rune stones glide until they hit something. Plan each push so the stones stop on the three seals; the button by the door resets them.

objectives.title: The Wellspring
objectives.text: At the bottom of everything, something is waiting. Go down and face it.
hints: Take the long stair beyond the vault. Bring food, armour and potions; the Keep's armoury and the vault chests can help.
Your foe throws a spear when you're far away and sends a surge of water when you're close. Keep moving; use your shield.
If you fall, you return just outside and can try again. When the fight is over, step into the centre of the Wellspring.

objectives.title: The Last Light
objectives.text: You carry the Ember. Bring it back to the Lantern Tower and relight the great lantern.
hints: A stair from the Wellspring climbs to the surface near the Singing Stones. From there, the Keep is close.
Climb the Lantern Tower to the very top.
Use the dark lens at the centre of the lantern room while holding the Ember.

objectives.title: Homecoming
objectives.text: The island remembers. Go back to Gullhaven and see the people you've come to know.
hints: The village has gathered in the market square for a festival.
Talk to everyone who matters to you. Hester especially has something to say.
When you're ready, tell Hester you'd like to walk down to the pier.

objectives.title: Cold Forge
objectives.text: Corin's forge has been cold for want of good steel. Bring him three ingots of Kestrel steel from the Keep's armoury.
hints: The Keep must be reachable first.
The armoury is on the east side of the Keep's bailey. Check its chests.
Bring the steel back to Corin's smithy, east of the square.

objectives.title: The Captain's Log
objectives.text: Tobias lost his logbook when his boat, the Meridian, sank in the bay. He can't remember the night it happened.
hints: Ask Hester for her Diver's Draught before diving.
The wreck lies west of the long pier in deep water. Look for a broken mast.
The log is in the sea-chest in the captain's cabin at the stern.

objectives.title: The Waystone Lamps
objectives.text: Light the four waystone lamps Maud Pike once kept, using her tinderbox.
hints: One lamp is on the harbour headland east of the village, another beside the waterfall in the Mosswood.
A third is on the path up Cairn Hill; the last is at the top of the old road, by the Keep.
Hold the tinderbox and use each lamp. Then return to Wendel's cottage on the western shore.

objectives.title: Her Mother's Bow
objectives.text: Wren's mother hid her bow in the Hollow Oak, deep in the Mosswood. Spiders have claimed it since.
hints: The Hollow Oak is in the dark south-west of the forest, past the waterfall.
The bow is in a chest inside the great trunk. Expect company.
Bring the bow back to Wren.

objectives.title: Fireflies
objectives.text: Wren asked you to meet her at the firefly glade after dark.
hints: The glade is east of Wren's lodge, around a small pond.
Go after nightfall. You can rest at the inn, or ask Wren to wait with you.
Talk to Wren at the glade.

objectives.title: The Missing Pages
objectives.text: Three pages are missing from Gullhaven's Chronicle. Ione has a few guesses where they went.
hints: Wendel Pike's late wife borrowed books from the Archive.
The Keep kept copies of everything; look in the Warden's rooms.
Pell's shop by the square wrapped its ledgers in old paper.

objectives.title: Stargazing
objectives.text: Ione asked you to meet her on the Archive roof tonight.
hints: Climb the ladder on the Archive's top floor.
Go after nightfall.
Talk to Ione on the roof.

objectives.title: The Gull's Wing
objectives.text: Sol needs a brass ship's compass, real sailcloth and a heartwood spar to finish her boat.
hints: The compass went down with the Meridian in the bay.
The Keep's stores might still hold sailcloth. Try the barracks.
Wren left a cut spar near the great fallen pine in the north-west Mosswood.

objectives.title: Sunset
objectives.text: Sol wants to take you out on the water at sunset.
hints: Meet her at the end of the long pier.
Go in the evening, as the sun sets.
Talk to Sol on the pier.
